learnTrack.title: Quieting Your Thoughts
learnTrack.headline: Your mind thinks 60,000 thoughts a day—most are reruns

growTrack.title: Mindfulness Practice - Starting Small
growTrack.learning_objective: Develop a simple daily practice to quiet mental chatter
growTrack.activity: Set a timer for 3 minutes. Sit comfortably, close your eyes, and count your breaths from 1 to 10. When you lose count, start over without judgment.

intro.text: Good morning. I'm Kelly, and this is Day 352.

learn_hook.text: Right now, as you listen to this, your mind is running background processes—worries, to-dos, random memories. What if you could turn down that noise?

learn_core.text: Your brain generates about 60,000 thoughts daily. Here's the kicker: 95% are repetitive—the same worries, the same mental loops. Neuroscience shows we can't force thoughts away, but we can redirect attention. A breath, a sensation—these anchors give the mind somewhere to rest.

learn_wisdom.text: You don't need to stop your thoughts—just stop following them. The river of your mind will always flow. Your power is choosing where to place your attention.

transition.text: Now let's turn learning into action.

grow_intro.text: Today's growth challenge: Mindfulness Practice. We're starting small.

grow_activity.text: Set a timer for just 3 minutes. Sit comfortably, close your eyes, and count your breaths from 1 to 10. When you lose count—and you will—start over without judgment. That's the practice.

grow_connect.text: Three minutes is all it takes to start rewiring how your brain handles mental chatter. Quiet isn't a talent—it's a skill you can build.

close.text: That's Day 352. Tomorrow, we explore being fully present. Until then, let your thoughts pass like clouds. See you tomorrow.
